CustomField.formula:
IF(ISNULL(
(5 * ( FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE(PhaseHStartDate__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( DATEVALUE(PhaseHStartDate__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) )
-
(5 * ( FLOOR( ( ApplicationReceivedDate__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( ApplicationReceivedDate__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) )
) , 0,
(5 * ( FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE(PhaseHStartDate__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( DATEVALUE(PhaseHStartDate__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) )
-
(5 * ( FLOOR( ( ApplicationReceivedDate__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( ApplicationReceivedDate__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) )
)
CustomField.label: Application Processing (Business Days)
